dataset_title: Green-biorefinery pilot energy, scale and storage-loss benchmarks
source_title: Environmental impacts of a biorefinery integrated into dairy farming system
source_location: Methods, sections Forage production and GBR process; article paragraphs reporting pilot energy, modeled facility design, and literature-applied stage losses.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) for the article, subject to third-party-material notices.
data_basis: Three reported pilot energy values; modeled capacity/operating assumptions; stage-specific DM-loss factors the article attributes to Hedström (2015); and one transparent arithmetic check.
applicability: Norwegian cultivated grass-clover green-biorefinery pilot and integrated dairy case. Useful for Phase 2/4 process-energy and scale benchmarking and Phase 3 loss-stage evidence review. Not roadside grass and not GreenHub-specific.

record_class_policy.B_reported_pilot_measurement: Aggregate electricity and propane heat reported from Tuv pilot facility measurements.
record_class_policy.C_study_design_assumption: Facility capacity, juice-line capacity, buffer tank and annual operating schedule are study design/model assumptions.
record_class_policy.C_literature_based_factor: Loss factors are values applied by the article and attributed to Hedström (2015), not independently measured within this study.
record_class_policy.C_derived_from_reported_values: Energy arithmetic check derived from rounded components; not a measurement.

limitations: Cultivated grass-clover is not roadside grass; the site, feed quality, and integrated dairy context differ from GreenHub.
The main article reports facility-aggregate energy, not the individual unit-operation electricity values, despite describing current measurement by unit.

The reported 1489 MJ/Mg DM total is 1 MJ/Mg DM above the sum reconstructed from rounded components (375 kWh/Mg DM × 3.6 + 138 MJ/Mg DM = 1488 MJ/Mg DM); retain the source total and show the rounding check separately.
Capacity, buffer, annual days and hours are modeled facility-design values, not observed sustained annual throughput.
Storage/harvest loss factors are secondarily reported literature factors attributed by the paper to Hedström (2015); do not treat them as roadside-grass or GreenHub measurements.
All records remain reference-only; no runtime parameter mapping or default activation.
